customManagers.description: A release tag with the sha256 of one of its assets pinned on the next line (Ansible downloads). The github-release-attachments datasource bumps the tag and re-pins the digest from the new release's own checksums file, without running anything (Mend-hosted Renovate does not run postUpgradeTasks). The value must be the exact git tag, so it has its own comment: the generic `# renovate: datasource=` manager would otherwise also match it and bump the tag without the digest.

OpenSandbox component image tags we pin ourselves (execd/egress in the server configToml, execd/task-executor in the ci-vm Pool templates) must match the chart's release. Same depName and datasource as the GitRepository tag, and the sandbox group puts both in one PR.

Versions Renovate cannot see on its own (e.g. an image tag inside HelmRelease values): put `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` on the line above. A pinned digest goes on the same line (`tag@sha256:…`) so it is bumped with the tag.
A whole image reference Renovate cannot see (an image in HelmRelease values or in a post-render patch): put `# renovate: image` on the line above `key: repo:tag@sha256:…`.

packageRules.description: Automerge digest bumps of floating Docker Hub tags (e.g. postgres:18-alpine) once CI passes. No minimumReleaseAge: floating tags are rebuilt for security patches, and Docker Hub restarts the age on every re-push, so a tag rebuilt more often than the delay would never merge. Docker Hub only because those are the images reviewed for this; our own zot images may have another writer (see the backstage rule below). Full-version tags excluded: a new digest there means upstream re-pushed a released version, which a human should see. platformAutomerge off: main requires no status checks, so Gitea-native automerge would merge before CI (flux-diff, lint) finishes; Renovate's own automerge waits for every check to pass.
Flux image automation owns this digest (platform/flux-image-automation); two writers would fight.

OpenSandbox GitRepository follows upstream release tags (release-x.y.z, one platform version for server, charts and images). Skip release candidates; the chart and the execd/egress image tags in values.yaml move together, so this stays a manual-review PR.
Our own images, pinned by bare digest and bumped by hand when gitea-dynamic-runner ships. The repo has no `latest` tag, so Renovate can only fail to resolve a new digest.
Pinned to a commit after 1.2.2 for #561 (configurable server config mode, needed for 0600). Tags would only offer a downgrade; take the next release.
One PR for all provider bumps: CI plans every root on each PR anyway, so splitting only multiplies runs.
Sandbox is disposable; opensandbox execd/task-executor/chart must move together anyway.
Same chart in both clusters; keep them on one version.
CLI is pinned to match local terraform: a newer CLI rewrites state that an older local binary then cannot read. Upgrade both together.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **合并前**：本地 terraform 先升到同一版本。CI 用新 CLI 写过的 state，本地旧版本读不了。

packageRules.description: Sidecar must follow the bao server (openbao_version, Ansible, checksum-pinned). The PR carries the steps; nothing merges itself. Own group: the observability group (by path) would otherwise swallow it.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **这只是 vmagent 的 sidecar。** 先用 Ansible 升 bao 服务器（`infrastructure/openbao/ansible/group_vars/all/vars.yml` 的 `openbao_release` 与 `openbao_download_checksum`，Renovate 会一起提），再合并本 PR。

packageRules.description: Software installed on hosts by Ansible (`# renovate:` lines under infrastructure/**/ansible). Variables listed in .gitea/host-deploy.yml deploy on merge (host-deploy workflow); the rest stay manual, and the PR note says which. One PR per Ansible project per week: a project is one playbook run on one set of hosts, so a package per PR meant a maintenance window per package (8 PRs on 2026-11-18, three of them for the same PG hosts). Pinned checksums use `# renovate-attachment:` (see customManagers), so a bump re-pins them in the same PR (#799 shipped a stale one).
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **主机软件。** 变量在 `.gitea/host-deploy.yml` 白名单里的，合并后由 CI（host-deploy）部署并验证幂等；其余合并不会部署，按组件 README 跑对应 playbook（先 `--check --diff`，再正式跑，再跑一次应 `changed=0`）。写死的校验和随版本一起更新（`# renovate-attachment:`），在 diff 里核对。

packageRules.description: Our version variables are bare (3.7.2) and the playbooks add the tag's `v` themselves (…/download/v{{ x }}/…), so strip it from the release tag; otherwise the PR writes v3.7.3 and the URL becomes vv3.7.3. Variables that already carry the v (flux2, k3s) are left alone.
PGDG packages (infrastructure/shared-postgresql). pgBackRest refuses mixed versions across members, so every member moves together.
